verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent building blocks. Webhooks can drive real-time automatic scoring of LLM responses, a REST request-query API and an OpenAPI spec allow programmatic reads, and an llms.txt probe makes the docs agent-readable. Nothing shows an API for creating datasets or triggering a discrete eval run, so an agent would have to assemble this workflow from webhooks plus external scoring. Missing for 10: a programmatic dataset-creation API, an endpoint to trigger an eval run against a dataset, a documented way to read eval-run results, and hands-on corroboration of an agent-driven eval workflow.
